title_sq: Prane Qendres, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, Me Investim Fantastik !!
description_sq: Prane Qendres, Ne Rrugen Fortuzi, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1, Me Investim Fantastik. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje ndertimi te ri, te mireadministruar dhe me ashensor, me siperfaqe totale 70 m2. Organizohet ne korridorin hyres qe shperndan ambientet, ne sallonin e ndenjes me kend gatimi me vete, dhoma matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti i dites. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar ne cdo aspekt, parket, elektroshtepiake, vetrata dhe mobilim. Ka orientim jug/lindje qe e ben me drite dhe te ngrohte gjate gjithe dites. Zona ku ndodhet eshte nga me te mirat dhe te preferuara ne Tirane per nje cilesi te larte jetese. Eshte zone e qete dhe ka prane cdo facilitet te mundshem dhe aksesohet mjaft mire. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Near the Center, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, with fantastic investment!!
description_en: Near the Center, on Fortuzi Street, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale, with fantastic investment. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator, with a total area of ​​70 m2. It is organized in the entrance corridor that divides the premises, in the living room with its own cooking corner, matrimonial room with access to the balcony and the toilet of the day. The apartment is newly invested in every aspect, parquet, electrical appliances, windows and furniture. It has a south/east orientation that makes it bright and warm throughout the day. The area where it is located is one of the best and preferred in Tirana for a high quality of life. It is a quiet area and has every possible facility nearby and is very well accessible. It has full mortgage documentation.
